exact_before_after_ledger.before: A server sends ETag with response and that tag value must be included in If-None Match header for future conditional GET requests.
exact_before_after_ledger.after: A server sends ETag with the JSON response and the client includes that tag value in the If-None-Match header for future conditional GET requests.
exact_before_after_ledger.reason: DTC2: Restore the response type, identify the client as the sender, repair the protected header literal and missing articles; describe the supplied mechanism without an unqualified obligation.

exact_before_after_ledger.before: If the cached ETag matches a representation it reuses the cached one and returns 304 Not Modified, with no retransmission.
exact_before_after_ledger.after: If the cached ETag matches the selected representation, the client can reuse the cached body and the server returns 304 Not Modified, with no response body.
exact_before_after_ledger.reason: DTC3: Restore selected-representation scope, distinguish the client reuse actor from the server response actor, and specify absence of the response body rather than ambiguous no retransmission.

exact_before_after_ledger.before: If ETag does not match the server returns 200 OK with new response if further conditions are thereby satisfied.
exact_before_after_ledger.after: If ETag does not match, the server returns 200 OK with the current JSON for an otherwise successful GET.
exact_before_after_ledger.reason: DTC4: Replace the undefined further-conditions reference with the supplied otherwise-successful GET condition, restore current JSON and grammatical clause separation.

exact_before_after_ledger.before: Still this includes sending a request.
exact_before_after_ledger.after: Still this validation includes sending a request.
exact_before_after_ledger.reason: DTC5: Resolve this as the described validation, rather than the immediately preceding 200 response.

exact_before_after_ledger.before: Application may employ freshness policy as Cache-Control max age = 60 as an example, in which case this reuse does not depend on caching validation.
exact_before_after_ledger.after: An application may employ a freshness policy such as Cache-Control: max-age=60 as an example, in which case the cached response can be reused while fresh without a validation request, subject to other caching rules.
exact_before_after_ledger.reason: DTC6: Repair missing articles and the example construction, restore the exact header literal, resolve the cached-response reference, and add the omitted while-fresh and other-caching-rules conditions.

exact_before_after_ledger.before: However reuse according to this is not a guarantee that relevant data has not changed for 60 seconds.
exact_before_after_ledger.after: However reuse according to this freshness policy is not a guarantee that relevant data will remain unchanged for 60 seconds.
exact_before_after_ledger.reason: DTC7: Resolve this as the freshness policy and correct retrospective unchanged-data wording to the supplied non-guarantee over the freshness interval.

claim_map.contract: DTC1: ETag enables stored-response validation. Strength: recommendation_supported_by_specification. Scope: Stored response; GET.

supporting_spans.text: ETag enables receiving applications to validate whether cached representations may be reused.

claim_map.contract: DTC2: Server supplies the ETag; client echoes it in If-None-Match. Strength: mechanism. Scope: Described conditional GET.

supporting_spans.text: A server sends ETag with the JSON response and the client includes that tag value in the If-None-Match header for future conditional GET requests.

claim_map.contract: DTC3: A matching tag produces 304, no body, and stored-body reuse. Strength: conditional_requirement. Scope: Selected representation; otherwise successful GET.

supporting_spans.text: If the cached ETag matches the selected representation, the client can reuse the cached body and the server returns 304 Not Modified, with no response body.

claim_map.contract: DTC4: A nonmatching tag permits 200 with current JSON. Strength: conditional_behavior. Scope: Successful GET, not every possible response.

supporting_spans.text: If ETag does not match, the server returns 200 OK with the current JSON for an otherwise successful GET.

claim_map.contract: DTC5: Validation still sends a request. Strength: categorical_within_scope. Scope: Described conditional validation.

supporting_spans.text: Still this validation includes sending a request.

claim_map.contract: DTC6: Freshness can permit reuse without validation; max-age=60 is illustrative. Strength: qualified_recommendation. Scope: Other caching rules apply.

supporting_spans.text: An application may employ a freshness policy such as Cache-Control: max-age=60 as an example, in which case the cached response can be reused while fresh without a validation request, subject to other caching rules.

claim_map.contract: DTC7: Fresh reuse does not guarantee unchanged origin data for 60 seconds. Strength: permission_and_non_guarantee. Scope: Illustrative freshness interval.

supporting_spans.text: However reuse according to this freshness policy is not a guarantee that relevant data will remain unchanged for 60 seconds.
